time_series.name: RSI(2) oversold in uptrend
time_series.thesis: Connors short-term reversion; buy panic dips while >200dma.

time_series.name: Bollinger %b lower-band reversion
time_series.thesis: Buy below the lower band inside an uptrend.

time_series.name: Pullback-from-20d-high reversion
time_series.thesis: Buy a >=7% pullback from the recent high while >200dma.

time_series.name: Stretch-below-20dma reversion
time_series.thesis: Buy when price is unusually far below its 20dma in an uptrend.

time_series.name: Down-day fade in uptrend
time_series.thesis: Fade a >=2% down day inside an uptrend.

time_series.name: Lower-low/higher-close reversal
time_series.thesis: Internal-bar reversal (lower low, higher close) in an uptrend.

time_series.name: NR7 volatility-contraction breakout
time_series.thesis: Buy the breakout after the tightest range in 7 bars.

time_series.name: Above 200dma trend
time_series.thesis: Long while above the 200dma (Faber-style risk gate).

time_series.name: Own 12-1 momentum > 0
time_series.thesis: Long while trailing 12-1 total return is positive.

time_series.name: Rising 50dma
time_series.thesis: Long while the 50dma is rising and price is above it.

time_series.name: Donchian 55/20 breakout
time_series.thesis: Turtle channel breakout with a 20-day trailing exit.

time_series.name: Vol-targeted 200dma trend
time_series.thesis: Above-200dma trend sized to a 15% vol target.

time_series.name: Low-volatility state
time_series.thesis: Long while realized vol sits below its 1-year median (low-vol anomaly).

entry_timing.name: Entry-timing composite (blended oversold overlay)
entry_timing.interpretation: Entry composite is an OVERLAY: it improves the SHORT-HORIZON entry of a name already selected (positive blended IC, top-vs-bottom oversold quintile spread). It does not beat always-invested standalone — its role is better fills + shallower entry drawdown, gated by the validated uptrend filter.

selection.name: Selection composite (12-1 + residual momentum)
selection.survivorship: BIASED — context only, never sizes alone

vol_managed.name: Vol-managed sizing (Moreira-Muir / Barroso-Santa-Clara)
vol_managed.interpretation: Vol-targeting holds ~constant risk → higher Sharpe and shallower drawdown vs the unscaled sleeve. A capital-efficiency lever, kept regardless of IC; the levered variant adds return in calm regimes.

regime_conditioning.name: Regime-conditioning of the entry-timing edge
regime_conditioning.recommendation: Edge roughly regime-stable; light conditioning only.
